```{r mixomics_integration, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Description: Multi-omics integration analysis using MINT (mixOmics)
# Workflow: Part 03 - Multi-modal integration

library(mixOmics)
library(dplyr)

# ========== Load Data ==========
RNA <- read.csv('results/tables/tpm_rna.csv', row.names = 1)
ATAC <- read.csv('results/tables/integration/atac_promoter_genes.csv', row.names = 1)
RNA_group <- read.csv('data/rna_group.csv')
ATAC_group <- read.csv('data/atac_group.csv')

# ========== Data Integration ==========
# Find common genes
intgene <- intersect(rownames(RNA), rownames(ATAC))
new_RNA <- RNA[intgene, ]
new_ATAC <- ATAC[intgene, ]

# Combine data (keep row order)
new_data <- cbind(new_RNA, new_ATAC)
t_new_data <- t(new_data)  # Transpose to samples × genes matrix

# ========== Prepare Group Information ==========
# Extract sample and colour columns
rna_group_sub <- RNA_group[, c("sample", "colour")]
atac_group_sub <- ATAC_group[, c("sample", "colour")]

# Combine groups
new_group <- rbind(rna_group_sub, atac_group_sub)

# ========== Align Group Order with Data Order ==========
new_group <- new_group[match(rownames(t_new_data), new_group$sample), ]

# Check perfect match
if (!all(rownames(t_new_data) == new_group$sample)) {
  stop("Sample names in data and group file do not match")
}

# Add omics information
new_group$omics <- c(rep('RNA', nrow(RNA_group)), rep('ATAC', nrow(ATAC_group)))

# Unify color naming
new_group <- new_group %>%
  mutate(colour = ifelse(colour == "Black", "black", colour)) %>%
  mutate(colour = ifelse(colour == "Gray", "gray", colour))

# Convert to factors
omics <- as.factor(new_group$omics)
colour <- as.factor(new_group$colour)

# ========== MINT Analysis ==========
set.seed(123)
mint_data <- mint.plsda(
  X = t_new_data,
  Y = colour,
  study = omics,
  ncomp = 10,
  scale = TRUE
)

# ========== Visualization ==========
plotIndiv(mint_data, legend = TRUE)

# ========== Extract Results ==========
ATAC$gene <- rownames(ATAC)
mint <- as.data.frame(t(mint_data$X))
mint.x <- mint_data$variates$X
mint.loading <- mint_data$loadings$X
loading <- as.data.frame(mint.loading)
loading$gene <- rownames(loading)

# ========== Save Results ==========
dir.create("results/tables/integration", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write.csv(loading, "results/tables/integration/mint_loadings.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r extract_loading_genes, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Description: Extract significant genes from MINT PLS-DA loadings using Z-score threshold
# Workflow: Part 03 - Multi-modal integration

# ========== Extract MINT PLS-DA Significant Genes ==========
library(dplyr)

# ========== Configuration ==========
OUTPUT_DIR <- "results/tables/loading_genes"
target_p <- 0.1                # Two-tailed significance level
fallback_top_pct <- 0.05        # Fallback top percentage if no significant genes
ncomp_to_extract <- 2           # Extract first 2 components

# Create output directory
dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ========== Prepare Loading Matrix ==========
if (!exists("mint_data") || is.null(mint_data$loadings$X)) {
  stop("mint_data$loadings$X not found. Run MINT analysis first.")
}

loading_mat <- as.matrix(mint_data$loadings$X)
if (is.null(rownames(loading_mat))) {
  rownames(loading_mat) <- paste0("gene_", seq_len(nrow(loading_mat)))
}

# Calculate Z-score threshold
z_threshold <- qnorm(1 - target_p / 2)

# ========== Main Loop ==========
all_topload <- vector("list", length = ncomp_to_extract)

for (i in 1:ncomp_to_extract) {
  pc_loading <- loading_mat[, i]
  
  # Standardize to Z-score
  if (sd(pc_loading) == 0) {
    pc_z <- rep(0, length(pc_loading))
  } else {
    pc_z <- as.numeric(scale(pc_loading))
  }
  names(pc_z) <- rownames(loading_mat)
  
  # Find significant genes
  pos_idx <- which(pc_z > z_threshold)
  neg_idx <- which(pc_z < -z_threshold)
  
  # Fallback if no significant genes
  if (length(pos_idx) + length(neg_idx) == 0 && fallback_top_pct > 0) {
    ntop <- max(1, round(fallback_top_pct * length(pc_loading)))
    pos_idx <- order(pc_loading, decreasing = TRUE)[1:ntop]
    neg_idx <- order(pc_loading)[1:ntop]
  }
  
  # Positive significant
  positive <- if (length(pos_idx) > 0) {
    data.frame(
      gene = names(pc_z)[pos_idx],
      zscore = pc_z[pos_idx],
      loading = pc_loading[pos_idx],
      group = "positive",
      component = i,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ) %>% arrange(desc(zscore))
  } else data.frame()
  
  # Negative significant
  negative <- if (length(neg_idx) > 0) {
    data.frame(
      gene = names(pc_z)[neg_idx],
      zscore = pc_z[neg_idx],
      loading = pc_loading[neg_idx],
      group = "negative",
      component = i,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ) %>% arrange(zscore)
  } else data.frame()
  
  # Combine
  topload <- bind_rows(positive, negative)
  
  # Save
  out_file <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, paste0("mint_comp", i, "_genes.csv"))
  write.csv(topload, out_file, row.names = FALSE)
  
  all_topload[[i]] <- topload
}

# ========== Combine All Components ==========
final_table <- bind_rows(all_topload)
final_file <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "mint_all_components_genes.csv")
write.csv(final_table, final_file, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r loading_heatmap, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Description: Heatmap visualization of loading genes for PLS-DA components
# Workflow: Part 03 - Multi-modal integration

# ========== Loading Heatmap for PLS-DA Components ==========
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(grid)

# ========== Define Plot Function ==========
plot_loading_heatmap <- function(i) {
  
  # ====== 1. Get top genes ======
  if (exists("all_topload") && length(all_topload) >= i) {
    top_genes <- unique(all_topload[[i]]$gene)
  } else {
    csvf <- file.path("results/tables/loading_genes", paste0("mint_comp", i, "_genes.csv"))
    if (file.exists(csvf)) {
      top_genes <- unique(read.csv(csvf, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)$gene)
    } else {
      stop("Cannot find all_topload or mint_comp", i, "_genes.csv")
    }
  }
  
  # ====== 2. Build expression matrix ======
  if (!exists("mint")) {
    mint <- t(t_new_data)  # rows = genes, columns = samples
  }
  
  HM <- mint[rownames(mint) %in% top_genes, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(HM) == 0) stop("HM is empty: check gene name consistency")
  HM <- log(HM + 1)
  
  # Row-wise Z-score normalization
  HM_scaled <- t(scale(t(HM)))
  HM_scaled[is.na(HM_scaled)] <- 0
  
  # ====== 3. Order samples by PLS-DA scores ======
  if (exists("mint.x") && ncol(mint.x) >= i) {
    HM_scaled <- HM_scaled[, order(mint.x[colnames(HM_scaled), i]), drop = FALSE]
  }
  
  # ====== 4. Column annotation ======
  col_anno <- data.frame(
    Omics = new_group$omics,
    Colour = new_group$colour,
    row.names = new_group$sample
  )
  
  annotation_col <- col_anno[colnames(HM_scaled), , drop = FALSE]
  
  # ====== 5. Color settings ======
  # Main heatmap colors
  color_palette <- colorRampPalette(c("#2166ac", "white", "#b2182b"))(100)
  breaks_range <- seq(-2, 2, length.out = 91)
  
  # Annotation colors
  annotation_colors <- list(
    Omics = c(RNA = "#4DAF4A", ATAC = "#984EA3"),
    Colour = c(black = "#2166AC", gray = "#B2182B")
  )
  
  # ====== 6. Generate heatmap ======
  pm <- pheatmap(HM_scaled,
                 cluster_rows = TRUE,
                 cluster_cols = FALSE,
                 show_rownames = FALSE,
                 show_colnames = FALSE,
                 annotation_col = annotation_col,
                 annotation_colors = annotation_colors,
                 annotation_legend = TRUE,
                 legend = TRUE,
                 main = paste0(""),
                 color = color_palette,
                 breaks = breaks_range,
                 border_color = NA,
                 annotation_names_col = TRUE,
                 treeheight_row = 0,
                 fontsize = 10,
                 clustering_method = "ward.D2")
  
  # ====== 7. Save ======
  outdir <- "results/figures"
  dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  outfn <- file.path(outdir, paste0("mint_var", i, "_loading_heatmap.png"))
  
  png(outfn, width = 8, height = 5, units = "in", res = 300)
  grid::grid.draw(pm$gtable)
  dev.off()
  
  return(pm)
}

# ========== Generate heatmaps for var1 and var2 ==========
hm1 <- plot_loading_heatmap(1)
hm2 <- plot_loading_heatmap(2)
```

```{r omics_correlation, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Description: Correlation analysis between RNA and ATAC log2 fold changes
# Workflow: Part 03 - Multi-modal integration

library(ggpubr)
library(ggplot2)

# Create example expression data frame
gene_name <- unique(c(all_topload[[1]]$gene))
expr_RNA <- subset(RNA, rownames(RNA) %in% gene_name)
fold_changes <- data.frame(matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(expr_RNA), ncol = 1))
names(fold_changes) <- "RNA"
row.names(fold_changes) <- gene_name

# Use new_group to match black/gray samples
rna_samples_black <- new_group$sample[new_group$omics == "RNA" & new_group$colour == "black"]
rna_samples_gray <- new_group$sample[new_group$omics == "RNA" & new_group$colour == "gray"]

# Extract means for control and experimental groups
black_means <- rowMeans(expr_RNA[, rna_samples_black, drop = FALSE])
gray_means <- rowMeans(expr_RNA[, rna_samples_gray, drop = FALSE])  
expr_RNA$fc <- log(gray_means / black_means)
expr_RNA$gene <- row.names(expr_RNA)
expr_RNA <- expr_RNA[,(ncol(expr_RNA) - 1):ncol(expr_RNA)]

expr_ATAC <- subset(ATAC, rownames(ATAC) %in% gene_name)
atac_samples_black <- new_group$sample[new_group$omics == "ATAC" & new_group$colour == "black"]
atac_samples_gray <- new_group$sample[new_group$omics == "ATAC" & new_group$colour == "gray"]

black_means <- rowMeans(expr_ATAC[, atac_samples_black, drop = FALSE])
gray_means <- rowMeans(expr_ATAC[, atac_samples_gray, drop = FALSE])  
expr_ATAC$fc <- log(gray_means / black_means)
expr_ATAC$gene <- row.names(expr_ATAC)
expr_ATAC <- expr_ATAC[,(ncol(expr_ATAC) - 1):ncol(expr_ATAC)]

fold_changes <- merge(expr_RNA, expr_ATAC, by = 'gene')
names(fold_changes) <- c('gene', "Log2FC(RNA)", "Log2FC(ATAC)")

# Set quantile range (keep 1%–99% interval)
lower_rna <- quantile(fold_changes$`Log2FC(RNA)`, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE)
upper_rna <- quantile(fold_changes$`Log2FC(RNA)`, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
lower_atac <- quantile(fold_changes$`Log2FC(ATAC)`, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE)
upper_atac <- quantile(fold_changes$`Log2FC(ATAC)`, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)

# Filter out extreme values
fold_changes_filtered <- subset(fold_changes,
  `Log2FC(RNA)` >= lower_rna & `Log2FC(RNA)` <= upper_rna &
  `Log2FC(ATAC)` >= lower_atac & `Log2FC(ATAC)` <= upper_atac)

# ====== Enhanced Scatter Plot ======
omics_cor <- ggplot(fold_changes_filtered, aes(x = `Log2FC(RNA)`, y = `Log2FC(ATAC)`)) +
  # Points
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7, color = "#2c7fb8") +
  
  # Reference lines
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray70", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray70", linewidth = 0.4) +
  
  # Fitted line
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1) +
  
  # Correlation labels
  stat_cor(method = "pearson", 
           label.x = 0.75,
           label.y = -0.13,
           size = 5, color = "black") +
  
  # Theme styling
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.8, color = "black"),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 13),
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16)
  ) +
  
  # Axis labels
  labs(
    title = "",
    x = "Log2FC (RNA expression)",
    y = "Log2FC (ATAC accessibility)"
  )

print(omics_cor)

# Save figure
outdir <- "results/figures"
dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
ggsave(file.path(outdir, "omics_correlation.png"), 
       plot = omics_cor, width = 8, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

```{r enrichment_dotplot, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Description: Enrichment dot plot for integrated multi-omics analysis
# Workflow: Part 03 - Multi-modal integration

# ========== Enrichment Dot Plot for Integration Analysis ==========
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# ========== Load Data ==========
df_wide <- read.csv("data/integration_enrichment.csv", 
                     check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# ========== Reshape to Long Format ==========
df_long <- df_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("_LogP_"),
    names_to = "Condition",
    names_prefix = "_LogP_",
    values_to = "LogP"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    LogP = as.numeric(LogP),
    score = -LogP,
    Description = factor(Description, levels = rev(unique(Description))),
    var = case_when(
      grepl("var1", Condition) ~ "PLS-DA var1",
      grepl("var2", Condition) ~ "PLS-DA var2"
    ),
    direction = case_when(
      grepl("Gray", Condition) ~ "Gray-associated",
      grepl("Black", Condition) ~ "Black-associated"
    ),
    x_label = paste0(var, "\n(", direction, ")")
  ) %>%
  filter(score > 0)

# ========== Set Factor Order ==========
x_order <- c(
  "PLS-DA var1\n(Gray-associated)",
  "PLS-DA var2\n(Gray-associated)", 
  "PLS-DA var1\n(Black-associated)",
  "PLS-DA var2\n(Black-associated)"
)
df_long$x_label <- factor(df_long$x_label, levels = x_order)

# ========== Color Scheme ==========
var_colors <- c(
  "PLS-DA var1\n(Gray-associated)" = "#E41A1C",
  "PLS-DA var2\n(Gray-associated)" = "#E41A1C",
  "PLS-DA var1\n(Black-associated)" = "#1f77b4",
  "PLS-DA var2\n(Black-associated)" = "#1f77b4"
)

# ========== Generate Dot Plot ==========
p <- ggplot(df_long, aes(x = x_label, y = Description)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = score, color = x_label), alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_color_manual(values = var_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_size_continuous(
    name = expression(bold(-log[10](p))),
    range = c(5, 12),
    breaks = c(2, 5, 10, 20)
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("var1\nGray", "var2\nGray", "var1\nBlack", "var2\nBlack")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, color = "black", face = "bold", 
                               angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.8, "cm"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.5),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  ) +
  labs(title = "", x = NULL, y = NULL)

print(p)

# ========== Save ==========
ggsave("results/figures/integration_enrichment_bubble.png", 
       p, width = 8, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```
